name: Patch-up station
brief: MK-085 Patch-up station: the base's first-aid wall. A white cabinet with a glowing green plus (lit = ready), a pull-out drawer of plasters and suit patches, a fold-down seat at kid height and a big friendly press button. PG: it fixes scrapes and suit tears, nothing scary.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
